name: python-observability
Use structlog for structured JSON logs with consistent fields; Prometheus metrics; OpenTelemetry traces. Propagate unique correlation IDs via `X-Correlation-ID`. Track latency, traffic, errors, and saturation at every service boundary. Include request, user, and operation context; use timing context managers; test observability; set alerts. For local development, consider human-readable formats.
Keep metric label values bounded. Unbounded labels (like user IDs) explode storage costs.
Never log expected behavior at `ERROR`. A user entering a wrong password is `INFO`, not `ERROR`.
Avoid labels with unbounded values to prevent metric explosion.
Never use unbounded values as metric labels.
Don't cry wolf with ERROR.
